name: wfgate
description: Workflow gate harness: the workflow-gate skill (operating manual), the gate-sweep reviewer agent (mutation sweeps, launch it with isolation: "worktree"), and two PreToolUse reminder hooks — one on the Workflow tool for the launch, one on Write|Edit for the authoring the launch hook is too late for. The wf/wfcheck/wfdry binaries are installed separately by `make install` from this same repo.
